answer: Latent Correlation Audit: after the fact, cluster agent identities by shared behavior fingerprints—timing offsets, rephrasing quirks, overlapping action sequences. Identities whose traces correlate above threshold form a cluster; the cluster's smallest member count sets a suspicion floor. Enforcement: a cluster's rewards are split by distinct trace, so an attacker sustaining many identities pays a per-identity cost in distinct behavioral obfuscation, roughly the effort of running a separate agent.
